why: Knowledge cells hold the stack's knowledge of words, and which of them win a race is a sparse code of what the stack recalls. Fast output synapses learn while reading and work best on stable, sparse keys. Do they learn more when they also hear which knowledge cells won (--teach-knowledge)?
models: the four trained knowledge-cell stacks of the knowledge-gap test (know-s1 to know-s4), unchanged

arms.cells: v15's rule on all six levels, hearing the threshold cells as before
arms.keyed: the same, also hearing which knowledge cells won every head's race at those levels

measure: The first 2,000,000 bytes of the enwik8 validation split as 16 unbroken streams (lead 8,192, pieces of 512), on a CPU. Every arm's threshold is picked for every seed from 2^21, 2^22 and 2^23 on the pieces of the first million bytes; the comparison is on the pieces of the second million, which picked nothing.
pass_mark: Knowledge keys pass if 'keyed' is ahead of 'cells' at all four seeds on the second million and by at least 0.003 on average. They then key the fast synapses of v17's full-size scoring as well.
seen_before_recording: No scoring with knowledge keys exists.

amendment.what: Where an arm's best threshold for a seed lies at the top of the range (2^23), the range is extended by powers of two until the best has a worse neighbour above it, as the trained-plasticity study extended its ranges. Recorded after seeing seed 20003 at 2^21 and 2^22 (cells 1.74345 and 1.70643, keyed 2.25237 and 1.87213 on the first two million bytes), both falling as the threshold rises; no score at 2^23 exists yet.

results_so_far.standing: Knowledge keys are behind at seeds 20003 and 20004 (0.0069 and 0.0058 on the second million at the best threshold of each arm), so the pass mark (ahead at all four seeds) can no longer be met: knowledge keys do not key v17's fast synapses. Seeds 20001 and 20002 are still being scored, for the size of the effect. With the keys the fast synapses need a threshold four times higher, as the knowledge cells' wins swamp the one pool of fibres they share with the threshold cells.
